categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Sinopep-Allsino Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. focuses on peptide drugs, small molecule chemical drugs, and oligonucleotide drugs, combining independent R&D with customized development and manufacturing (CDMO) services. The company operates in pharmaceutical intermediates, APIs, and formulations, targeting diseases such as diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, and cancer. It also provides contract development and manufacturing services for global innovative drug companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced solid-liquid fusion peptide synthesis technology enabling kilogram-scale production of long-chain modified peptides. It employs high-resolution mass spectrometry for quality control, innovative chromatographic purification techniques, and nanotechnology for controlled drug release. It also utilizes green chemistry platforms, asymmetric synthesis with homogeneous catalysis, enzyme immobilization, continuous flow reactions, and advanced oligonucleotide synthesis and conjugation technologies, including GalNAc conjugation for targeted delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global pharmaceutical companies such as Incyte, Gilead, Boehringer Ingelheim, Vertex, and domestic firms like Frontage and Zoetis. The company serves markets in the US, Europe, India, Canada, Latin America, and the Middle East, focusing on innovative drug developers and generic drug manufacturers. Its products support clinical trials, registration, and commercial production of drugs for major diseases including HIV/AIDS, cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular conditions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Lianyungang and Jiande, Zhejiang. It has a global commercial footprint with sales and partnerships across North America, Europe, India, Latin America, Middle East, and Southeast Asia. The company is expanding its international business through a matrix-style business development team covering traditional and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Sinopep-Allsino operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and supply of pharmaceutical intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and finished formulations. It also provides contract development and manufacturing services (CDMO) to innovative drug companies, supporting drug discovery through commercial production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company pursues a 'time-leading, technology-leading' strategy emphasizing interdisciplinary innovation. It invests heavily in R&D platforms for peptides, small molecules, oligonucleotides, and bioconjugates (XDC). It is advancing synthetic biology, gene therapy, photochemistry, electrochemistry, and AI-driven process chemistry. Strategic priorities include expanding commercial-scale production capacity, global business development, and building a resilient international supply chain through acquisitions and partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of APIs, intermediates, and formulations, as well as contract development and manufacturing services (CDMO) for global innovative pharmaceutical companies. The company also earns income from technology transfer and licensing services. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distributors, targeting both domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic biopharmaceutical firm specializing in peptide drugs and complex small molecules with significant scale and technological advantages. It competes with global CDMO providers and pharmaceutical manufacturers by leveraging advanced synthesis platforms and regulatory compliance. Its repeated successful FDA inspections and international certifications underscore its competitive standing in regulated markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.625 billion, a 57.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 404 million, up 148.19%. Total assets grew 43.15% to RMB 5.078 billion, and equity attributable to shareholders increased 22.58% to RMB 2.66 billion. R&D investment accounted for 22.88% of revenue, reflecting strong growth and expansion in scale and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced solid-liquid fusion peptide synthesis platform enabling large-scale, cost-effective production of complex long-chain peptides with high quality and yield. It offers integrated R&D and manufacturing services with global regulatory compliance, supporting innovative drug development and commercialization. Its internationalized business development team and comprehensive quality management systems provide customers with reliable, efficient, and high-value pharmaceutical solutions.
